title: Tobey Maguire Officiates Ex-Wife's Wedding in Hawaii
seoTitle: Tobey Maguire Officiates Ex-Wife's Hawaii Wedding
subtitle: The actor officiated the ceremony for jewelry designer Jennifer Meyer and Geoffrey Ogunlesi
excerpt: Actor Tobey Maguire, ex-husband of Jennifer Meyer, officiated his ex-wife's wedding to billionaire businessman Geoffrey Ogunlesi in a ceremony in Hawaii.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Tobey Maguire, 51, officiated the wedding ceremony of his ex-wife, jewelry designer Jennifer Meyer, and billionaire businessman Geoffrey Ogunlesi at a luxury hotel in Hawaii. The ceremony took place at the Four Seasons Resort Lanai on October 10, just days after the officialization of Jennifer and Tobey's divorce, which was finalized on September 21.

Tobey Maguire and Jennifer Meyer maintain close ties

Although they separated in 2016, Tobey and Jennifer remain very close. Tobey's decision to officiate Jennifer's wedding to Geoffrey demonstrates the cordial relationship between them. The two met in 2003 on the set of "Seabiscuit" and married in 2007, also in Hawaii.

Jennifer and Geoffrey Ogunlesi: a prominent couple

Jennifer Meyer and Geoffrey Ogunlesi began dating in November 2023 and got engaged a few months later. In May 2026, they welcomed their first child together. Geoffrey is the son of Nigerian lawyer and investment banker Adebayo Ogunlesi.

High-profile guests at the celebration

The ceremony was attended by celebrities such as Courteney Cox, Leonardo DiCaprio with his girlfriend Vittoria Ceretti, and Jeff Bezos with his wife Lauren Sánchez Bezos. Jennifer and Tobey's children, Ruby Sweetheart Maguire, 19, and Otis Tobias Maguire, 17, also attended the party.

A high-end wedding in Hawaii

The event was held at a Michelin-starred hotel, the Four Seasons Resort Lanai, reinforcing the luxurious nature of the celebration. The venue chosen was the same where the original couple married in 2007.

With information from Gshow, CNN Brasil.
